unity.rationale: Three release-device sessions had zero drops/unknown mappings and release audio drift passed EC-001, but dispatch jitter remains Not Measured.

godot.rationale: Three release-device sessions normalized every trigger, arrival spread passed, reconnect recovered, and CoreAudio release drift passed EC-001.

unity.rationale: CLI test/build/capture work with zero GUI interventions, with Unity licensing and a maintained native CoreMIDI plugin.

godot.rationale: CLI test/export/capture work with zero GUI interventions; the clean-cache defect was found and fixed from text source.

unity.rationale: Domain separation is clear, but the native CoreMIDI bridge adds platform-specific code and lifecycle handling.

godot.rationale: Typed GDScript and the standard MIDI API avoid a native plugin, with a known limitation in disconnect visibility.

unity.rationale: Deterministic 768x768 output, frame-independent kinematics, and zero-allocation pool tests pass; comparable release frame time is not measured.

godot.rationale: Deterministic 768x768 output and frame-independent kinematics pass; comparable release frame time is not measured.

unity.rationale: Clean release build completed in 12 seconds and three warmed measured builds had 3.316-second p50.

godot.rationale: Clean release export completed in 8 seconds and three warmed measured exports had 7.506-second p50; the universal export is substantially larger.

unity.rationale: The desktop native MIDI bridge cannot be reused by WebGL without a separate Web MIDI adapter.

godot.rationale: GDScript avoids C# restrictions for web export, though desktop InputEventMIDI still requires a separate web input path.

unity.rationale: The selected LTS toolchain is mature but subject to Unity licensing and editor activation requirements.

godot.rationale: Godot is MIT-licensed and the fixed toolchain runs without account or license activation.
